title: NBA: Harper, Wembanyama lead Spurs past Jazz for 5th straight win

blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO — Dylan Harper scored 17 points, Victor Wembanyama added 12 points, 11 rebounds and three blocks and the San Antonio Spurs rolled to their fifth straight victory, topping the Utah Jazz 119-97 on Monday night. Stephon Castle added 16 points and Keldon Johnson had 15 points as San Antonio won the first two of a three-game homestand. Lauri Markkanen had 22 points and eight rebounds for Utah, which lost its fifth straight.
